newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HIH Winterthur, LawCover in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: HIH Winterthur, LawCover in joint venture.

text.p: Insurance group HIH Winterthur International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it would form a joint venture with LawCover to market legal professional indemnity products in Australia.
"The Australian market for this type of insurance is estimated at A$100 million," HIH Winterthur said.

LawCover, Australia's largest mutual professional indemnity scheme for solicitors, currently provides insurance to the New South Wales legal profession through a scheme in which HIH Winterthur is the lead Australian underwriter.
"The existing comparable scheme in Victoria is expected to be opened to competition from 1 January 1998 and further competitive opportunities are anticipated around Australia," HIH Winterthur said.
